series.gdp: The total value added by goods and services produced within the country. Converted to USD using each year’s exchange rate.
series.gdpPerCapita: The value added by goods and services produced within the country, divided by the population. Converted to USD using each year’s exchange rate.
series.gdpNational: The total value added by goods and services produced within the country.
series.gdpNationalPerCapita: The value added by goods and services produced within the country, divided by the population.
series.gni: The total income earned by a country’s residents, both domestically and abroad. Converted to USD using each year’s exchange rate.
series.gniPerCapita: The total income earned by a country’s residents, both domestically and abroad, divided by population. Converted to USD using each year’s exchange rate.
series.realGdp: GDP adjusted for changes in prices.
series.realGdpPerCapita: GDP adjusted for changes in prices, divided by the population.
series.gdpGrowth: The annual percentage change in real GDP, adjusted for inflation.
series.inflationRate: The annual percentage change in the average prices of goods and services purchased by consumers.
series.unemploymentRate: People who are not employed, are available for work, and are actively seeking work, as a share of the labor force.
series.ppp: GDP adjusted for differences in price levels across countries. An international dollar has roughly the same purchasing power as $1 in the U.S.
series.pppPerCapita: GDP per capita adjusted for differences in price levels across countries. An international dollar has roughly the same purchasing power as $1 in the U.S.
series.population: The total number of people residing in the country.
series.populationGrowth: The annual percentage change in population, reflecting births, deaths, and international migration.
series.populationDensity: The number of people per square kilometer.
series.lifeExpectancy: The expected lifespan of a newborn based on current mortality rates.
series.fertilityRate: The number of children a woman would have over her lifetime based on current age-specific fertility rates.
series.immigrants: The total number of foreign-born people living in the country.
series.immigrantsPercentPopulation: Foreign-born people as a share of the total population.
series.currentAccountBalance: The net balance of goods, services, income, and transfers with the rest of the world. Converted to USD using each year’s exchange rate.
series.currentAccountBalancePercentGdp: The net balance of goods, services, income, and transfers with the rest of the world, as a share of nominal GDP.
series.tradeBalance: Exports minus goods imports. Excludes services. Converted to USD using each year’s exchange rate.
series.exports: Goods exports. Excludes services. Converted to USD using each year’s exchange rate.
series.imports: Goods imports. Excludes services. Converted to USD using each year’s exchange rate.
series.servicesTradeBalance: Services exports minus services imports. Converted to USD using each year’s exchange rate.
series.servicesExports: Services exports. Converted to USD using each year’s exchange rate.
series.servicesImports: Services imports. Converted to USD using each year’s exchange rate.
series.governmentGrossDebt: Gross government debt as a share of nominal GDP.
series.governmentNetDebt: Net government debt as a share of nominal GDP.
series.fiscalBalance: Revenue minus total expenditure, as a share of nominal GDP.
series.primaryFiscalBalance: Revenue minus expenditure excluding interest payments, as a share of nominal GDP.
series.primaryFiscalBalanceNational: Revenue minus expenditure excluding interest payments.
series.governmentRevenue: Government revenue, including taxes and social contributions, as a share of nominal GDP.
series.governmentRevenueNational: Government revenue, including taxes and social contributions.
series.governmentSpending: Government expenditure, including consumption, transfers, interest payments, and investment, as a share of nominal GDP.
series.governmentSpendingNational: Government expenditure, including consumption, transfers, interest payments, and investment.
series.totalReservesIncludingGold: Total reserves, including gold. Converted to USD using each year’s exchange rate.
series.militarySpending: Spending on armed forces and defense-related activities. Converted to USD using each year’s exchange rate.
series.militarySpendingPercentGdp: Spending on armed forces and defense-related activities, as a share of nominal GDP.
series.hdi: An index combining indicators of health, education, and income. Values range from 0 to 1.
series.co2Emissions: Greenhouse gas emissions excluding land use and forestry. Includes non-CO2 greenhouse gases expressed in CO2 equivalent.
series.co2EmissionsPerCapita: Greenhouse gas emissions per capita excluding land use and forestry. Includes non-CO2 greenhouse gases expressed in CO2 equivalent.
series.area: Total area, including both land and water.
series.forestAreaPercentOfLandArea: Forest area as a share of total land area.
